import pytest
from django.test import Client
from rest_framework.test import APIClient
from modules.cms.models import Complaint
from modules.cms.enums import ComplaintStatus

@pytest.fixture
def api_client():
    return APIClient()

@pytest.fixture
def complaint():
    return Complaint.objects.create(
        description='Test complaint',
        category='Test category',
        user=make_session('test_user'),
    )

def test_submit_complaint_mandatory_validation(api_client, complaint):
    response = api_client.post('/complaints/', data={
        'description': 'Test complaint',
        'category': 'Test category',
    })
    assert response.status_code == 201

    response = api_client.post('/complaints/', data={
        'description': 'Test complaint',
    })
    assert response.status_code == 400

    response = api_client.post('/complaints/', data={
        'category': 'Test category',
    })
    assert response.status_code == 400

def test_handler_assign_and_prioritize(api_client, complaint):
    # Assign handler and priority
    response = api_client.post(f'/complaints/{complaint.id}/assign/', data={
        'handler': 'test_handler',
        'priority': 'High',
    })
    assert response.status_code == 200
    complaint.refresh_from_db()
    assert complaint.handler == 'test_handler'
    assert complaint.priority == 'High'

    # Calculate SLA due date
    assert complaint.sla_due_date is not None

    # Log progress
    response = api_client.post(f'/complaints/{complaint.id}/progress/', data={
        'notes': 'In progress',
    })
    assert response.status_code == 200
    complaint.refresh_fromdb()
    assert complaint.progress_notes == 'In progress'

def test_progress_update(api_client, complaint):
    complaint.status = ComplaintStatus.SUBMITTED
    complaint.save()

    response = api_client.post(f'/complaints/{complaint.id}/progress/', data={
        'notes': 'In progress',
    })
    assert response.status_code == 200
    complaint.refresh_from_db()
    assert complaint.status == ComplaintStatus.IN_PROGRESS

def test_resolve_and_reject_validation(api_client, complaint):
    complaint.status = ComplaintStatus.IN_PROGRESS
    complaint.save()

    response = api_client.post(f'/complaints/{complaint.id}/resolve/', data={
        'resolution_details': 'Resolved',
    })
    assert response.status_code == 200
    complaint.refresh_from_db()
    assert complaint.status == ComplaintStatus.RESOLVED

    response = api_client.post(f'/complaints/{complaint.id}/reject/', data={
        'rejection_reason': 'Rejected',
    })
    assert response.status_code == 200
    complaint.refresh_from_db()
    assert complaint.status == ComplaintStatus.REJECTED

    response = api_client.post(f'/complaints/{complaint.id}/reject/', data={})
    assert response.status_code == 400

def test_closure_verification_paths(api_client, complaint):
    complaint.status = ComplaintStatus.RESOLVED
    complaint.save()

    # User verification
    response = api_client.post(f'/complaints/{complaint.id}/verify/', data={
        'verification_status': 'verified',
    })
    assert response.status_code == 200
    complaint.refresh_from_db()
    assert complaint.verification_status == 'verified'

    # Supervisor verification
    response = api_client.post(f'/complaints/{complaint.id}/supervisor_verify/', data={
        'verification_status': 'verified',
    })
    assert response.status_code == 200
    complaint.refresh_from_db()
    assert complaint.verification_status == 'verified'

    # Transition to Closed and record closure_timestamp
    assert complaint.closure_timestamp is not None

def test_reopening_lifecycle(api_client, complaint):
    complaint.status = ComplaintStatus.CLOSED
    complaint.save()

    # User requests reopen
    response = api_client.post(f'/complaints/{complaint.id}/reopen/', data={})
    assert response.status_code == 200
    complaint.refresh_from_db()
    assert complaint.status == ComplaintStatus.IN_PROGRESS

    # Supervisor denies
    response = api_client.post(f'/complaints/{complaint.id}/deny/', data={
        'rejection_reason': 'Denied',
    })
    assert response.status_code == 200
    complaint.refresh_from_db()
    assert complaint.status == ComplaintStatus.REJECTED

    # Supervisor approves
    response = api_client.post(f'/complaints/{complaint.id}/approve/', data={})
    assert response.status_code == 200
    complaint.refresh_from_db()
    assert complaint.status == ComplaintStatus.RESOLVED

def test_manual_and_sla_escalation(api_client, complaint):
    complaint.status = ComplaintStatus.IN_PROGRESS
    complaint.save()

    # Manual escalation
    response = api_client.post(f'/complaints/{complaint.id}/escalate/', data={
        'reason': 'Manual escalation',
    })
    assert response.status_code == 200
    complaint.refresh_from_db()
    assert complaint.status == ComplaintStatus.ESCALATED

    # Automatic SLA breach escalation
    complaint.sla_due_date = timezone.now() - timedelta(days=1)
    complaint.save()
    assert complaint.status == ComplaintStatus.ESCALATED

def test_feedback_submission(api_client, complaint):
    complaint.status = ComplaintStatus.RESOLVED
    complaint.save()

    response = api_client.post(f'/complaints/{complaint.id}/feedback/', data={
        'feedback': 'Good job',
    })
    assert response.status_code == 200
    complaint.refresh_from_db()
    assert complaint.feedback == 'Good job'

def test_announcement_publishing(api_client, complaint):
    # Handler publishes
    response = api_client.post('/announcements/', data={
        'title': 'Test announcement',
        'content': 'Test content',
    })
    assert response.status_code == 201

    # Visible to users
    response = api_client.get('/announcements/')
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert 'Test announcement' in response.data['results']
